questions.ar: كيف وصلت إليك هذه الفرصة الوظيفية لأول مرة؟
questions.en: Where did you first come across this particular job opportunity?
questions.condition: All outcomes; single choice
questions.action: Compare sourcing channels without confusing them with prior company awareness.

questions.ar: قبل أن تعرف بهذه الفرصة، هل كنت قد سمعت عن ثاندر سبلاي؟
questions.en: Before learning about this vacancy, had you heard of Thunder Supply?
questions.condition: All outcomes
questions.action: Separate existing awareness from awareness created by recruitment.

questions.ar: من أين كانت لديك معلومات عن الشركة قبل هذه الفرصة؟
questions.en: Which sources had given you information about the company before this opportunity?
questions.condition: B02 = Yes; select all that apply
questions.action: Identify reputation channels. Do not request the names of individuals.

questions.ar: بالتفكير في الفترة قبل التقديم، كيف تتذكر انطباعك عن الشركة كجهة عمل؟
questions.en: Thinking back to before you applied, how do you remember viewing the company as an employer?
questions.condition: B02 = Yes; allow No clear impression / Cannot recall
questions.action: Retrospective perception only; not a prospectively measured baseline.

questions.ar: بعد تجربة التوظيف التي مررت بها، ما انطباعك الحالي عن الشركة كجهة عمل؟
questions.en: After the recruitment experience you have had, what is your current impression of the company as an employer?
questions.condition: All outcomes; allow Not enough information
questions.action: Track employer impression separately by outcome and comparable journey depth.

questions.ar: ما الذي سمعته أو توقعته قبل التقديم، وكيف وافقت تجربتك ذلك أو اختلفت عنه، إن وُجد؟
questions.en: What had you heard or expected before applying, and how did your experience match or differ from that, if at all?
questions.condition: B02 = Yes; optional; do not request names
questions.action: Code themes neutrally: expectations confirmed, improved, worsened, mixed or unclear. Do not label claims false.

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم سهولة إكمال تقديمك لهذه الوظيفة؟
questions.en: How easy or difficult was it to complete your application for this vacancy?
questions.condition: Application completed; N/A for a directly sourced person who did not apply
questions.action: Review form friction or document requirements if difficult.

questions.ar: قبل التقديم، إلى أي درجة كانت المسؤوليات الرئيسية للوظيفة واضحة لك؟
questions.en: Before applying, how clear were the main responsibilities of this vacancy to you?
questions.condition: A vacancy description was seen; otherwise N/A
questions.action: Revise the job advertisement if clarity is low.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة ساعدتك المكالمة الأولية على فهم الخطوة التالية في التوظيف؟
questions.en: How clearly did the screening call establish what would happen next in the hiring process?
questions.condition: Screening call completed
questions.action: Improve the screening closing explanation and next-step message.

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم الطريقة التي نوقشت بها توقعاتك للراتب خلال المكالمة؟
questions.en: How would you rate the way your salary expectations were discussed during the call?
questions.condition: Salary expectations were discussed; otherwise N/A
questions.action: Review the tone and clarity of the salary discussion; do not request salary amounts in this survey.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة كانت تعليمات الجزء المتعلق باللغة الإنجليزية واضحة؟
questions.en: How clear were the instructions for the English-language part of the screening call?
questions.condition: English check completed; otherwise N/A
questions.action: Clarify what candidates should do; this does not measure their English ability.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة أتاحت لك مقابلة الموارد البشرية الأولى شرح خبراتك ذات الصلة؟
questions.en: How much opportunity did the first HR interview give you to explain your relevant experience?
questions.condition: First HR interview completed
questions.action: Review the interview structure and time allocated to candidate examples.

questions.ar: بعد مقابلة الموارد البشرية الأولى، إلى أي درجة أصبحت طبيعة العمل المتوقعة واضحة لك؟
questions.en: After the first HR interview, how clear was the work you would be expected to do?
questions.condition: First HR interview completed
questions.action: Review how the role is explained; separate it from the job-ad rating.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة أتاحت لك المقابلة التقنية عرض مهارات مرتبطة بمتطلبات الوظيفة؟
questions.en: How much opportunity did the technical interview give you to demonstrate skills relevant to this role?
questions.condition: Technical interview completed
questions.action: Review whether prompts allow relevant examples, rather than judging candidate technical performance.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة كانت الموضوعات التقنية التي نوقشت مرتبطة بالعمل المتوقع في هذه الوظيفة؟
questions.en: How closely did the technical topics discussed connect to the work expected in this role?
questions.condition: Technical interview completed; candidate may choose Cannot judge
questions.action: Review the competency-to-role mapping. This is candidate perception, not proof of assessment validity.

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم مناسبة الوقت المطلوب لإكمال الاختبار بالنسبة لهذه الوظيفة؟
questions.en: How reasonable was the time commitment required for the assessment for this role?
questions.condition: Assessment completed or attempted; otherwise do not show
questions.action: Review assessment burden and stated expected completion time.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة كانت تعليمات الاختبار واضحة؟
questions.en: How clear were the assessment instructions?
questions.condition: Assessment received or attempted
questions.action: Clarify instructions, deadlines and submission steps.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة كانت مهام الاختبار مرتبطة بمتطلبات الوظيفة كما فهمتها؟
questions.en: How closely did the assessment tasks match the role requirements as you understood them?
questions.condition: Assessment attempted; allow Cannot judge
questions.action: Review assessment relevance; do not treat perceived relevance as psychometric validation.

questions.ar: هل واجهت عائقًا في الوصول إلى الاختبار أو إكماله؟
questions.en: Did anything prevent or hinder you from accessing or completing the assessment?
questions.condition: Assessment received or attempted; select all that apply
questions.action: Route technical access issues to the assessment provider; review timing or accessibility support.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة أتاحت لك المقابلة النهائية استخدام أمثلة فعلية من خبرتك لشرح طريقة عملك؟
questions.en: How much opportunity did the final interview give you to use real examples from your experience to explain how you work?
questions.condition: Final behavioral interview completed
questions.action: Review behavioral prompts, probing and the time available for examples.

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم تنظيم الحوار بين أعضاء لجنة المقابلة النهائية؟
questions.en: How would you rate the coordination of the discussion among the final interview panel members?
questions.condition: Final behavioral interview completed
questions.action: Review panel roles, interruptions and repeated questioning.

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم احترافية تعامل المقابلين خلال [المقابلة]؟
questions.en: How would you rate the professional conduct of the interviewers during [interview]?
questions.condition: Repeat for each attended HR / technical / final interview in full version; compact version uses interview dropdown
questions.action: Review interviewer conduct at the relevant stage; do not rank individuals from small samples.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة كانت صياغة أسئلة [المقابلة] واضحة؟
questions.en: How clear was the wording of the questions asked during [interview]?
questions.condition: Relevant interview attended
questions.action: Review jargon, ambiguous questions and interview preparation.

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم التزام [المقابلة] بموعد البدء الذي أُبلغت به؟
questions.en: How would you rate adherence to the start time communicated for [interview]?
questions.condition: Relevant interview attended; allow No set time / Cannot recall
questions.action: Compare candidate feedback with actual scheduling records.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة كان الوقت المتاح لك للإجابة خلال [المقابلة] كافيًا؟
questions.en: How sufficient was the time available for you to answer during [interview]?
questions.condition: Relevant interview attended
questions.action: Review duration, number of prompts and interruptions.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة أُتيحت لك فرصة طرح أسئلتك خلال [المقابلة]؟
questions.en: How much opportunity did you have to ask your own questions during [interview]?
questions.condition: Relevant interview attended
questions.action: Reserve space for candidate questions.

questions.ar: هل حدث خلال [المقابلة] موقف جعلك تشعر بعدم الاحترام أو بعدم الارتياح؟
questions.en: Did anything during [interview] make you feel disrespected or uncomfortable?
questions.condition: Relevant interview attended; optional; optional comment without names
questions.action: Route for confidential HR review; do not automatically forward allegations to the interviewer.

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم سرعة تحديثك بشأن وضع طلبك خلال رحلة التوظيف؟
questions.en: How would you rate the speed of the updates you received about your application?
questions.condition: All outcomes; allow No updates received, coded separately
questions.action: Review update service levels. Missing updates are not N/A.

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم مدة الانتظار بين مراحل التوظيف التي مررت بها؟
questions.en: How reasonable were the waiting periods between the recruitment stages you experienced?
questions.condition: At least two stages experienced; otherwise skip
questions.action: Review stage turnaround times without assuming the cause of delay.

questions.ar: بين أي مرحلتين كان الانتظار الأكثر إزعاجًا بالنسبة لك؟
questions.en: Between which stages was the wait most frustrating for you?
questions.condition: C02 = 1 or 2; show only experienced stage transitions
questions.action: Identify the bottleneck; avoid exact dates in anonymous rejection responses.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة كان الغرض من التحقق من المراجع أو الخلفية واضحًا لك؟
questions.en: How clear was the purpose of the reference or background checks to you?
questions.condition: Candidate was informed checks were initiated; label the actual check performed
questions.action: Review the explanation provided; do not ask the candidate to evaluate unseen checks.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة كانت المعلومات المطلوب منك توفيرها لإتمام التحقق واضحة؟
questions.en: How clear was the information you were asked to provide for the checks?
questions.condition: Candidate was asked for check-related information
questions.action: Review requests and instructions; do not collect reference names or check findings in the survey.

questions.ar: قبل توقيع العرض، إلى أي درجة كانت شروطه واضحة لك؟
questions.en: Before signing, how clear were the terms of the offer to you?
questions.condition: Offer signed only
questions.action: Review offer explanation and opportunities to clarify terms.

questions.ar: هل وجدت في العرض اختلافًا مهمًا عما فهمته من المناقشات السابقة؟
questions.en: Did the offer contain any important difference from what you understood from earlier discussions?
questions.condition: Offer received; signed or withdrawn outcome; optional explanation
questions.action: Review expectation mismatches; do not treat every difference as a breach.

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم الوقت الذي أُتيح لك لمراجعة العرض قبل اتخاذ قرارك؟
questions.en: How would you rate the time you were given to review the offer before deciding?
questions.condition: Offer received
questions.action: Review offer deadlines and candidate requests for clarification.

questions.ar: ما السبب الرئيسي الذي دفعك لعدم الاستمرار في هذه الفرصة؟
questions.en: What was the main reason you decided not to continue with this opportunity?
questions.condition: Withdrawn only; single main reason; permit Prefer not to say
questions.action: Separate process-related withdrawal from role fit, competing offers and personal circumstances.

questions.ar: هل كان هناك تغيير واقعي من جانبنا كان سيجعلك تفكر في الاستمرار؟
questions.en: Was there a realistic change on our side that might have made you consider continuing?
questions.condition: Withdrawn only; optional; accept No
questions.action: Review avoidable losses without promising a revised offer or reopening the process.

questions.ar: هل ترغب أن يتواصل معك فريق الموارد البشرية لفهم ملاحظاتك بشكل أفضل؟
questions.en: Would you like HR to contact you to understand your feedback better?
questions.condition: Withdrawn only; answers are identified; follow-up is optional
questions.action: Follow up only if requested; do not turn consent into compulsory contact.

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم احترام الصياغة المستخدمة لإبلاغك بعدم الاستمرار؟
questions.en: How would you rate the respectfulness of the message informing you that your application would not progress?
questions.condition: Rejection message actually sent; anonymous response path
questions.action: Review rejection wording and tone; do not rate satisfaction with the rejection decision itself.

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة كانت نتيجة طلبك واضحة في رسالة الرفض؟
questions.en: How clearly did the rejection message communicate the outcome of your application?
questions.condition: Rejection sent only
questions.action: Remove vague closure wording without promising individual feedback.

questions.ar: ما الذي كان سيجعل طريقة إنهاء التواصل معك أفضل؟
questions.en: What could have improved the way we concluded communication with you?
questions.condition: Rejection sent only; optional; remind candidate not to identify themselves
questions.action: Improve closure practice; never attempt to re-identify the respondent.

questions.ar: ما العامل الأكثر تأثيرًا في قرارك قبول العرض؟
questions.en: Which factor had the greatest influence on your decision to accept the offer?
questions.condition: Offer signed only; one primary factor
questions.action: Compare attraction factors with the employer proposition; not an onboarding satisfaction measure.

questions.ar: هل بقي موضوع متعلق بالعرض تحتاج إلى توضيحه قبل المباشرة؟
questions.en: Is there anything about the offer you still need clarified before starting?
questions.condition: Offer signed only; identified response; optional
questions.action: Ask HR to clarify outstanding offer matters before the start date.

questions.ar: بشكل عام، ما مدى رضاك عن تجربة التوظيف التي مررت بها معنا؟
questions.en: Overall, how satisfied are you with the recruitment experience you had with us?
questions.condition: All outcomes; completed experience only
questions.action: Track overall experience separately from the hiring decision.

questions.ar: استنادًا إلى تجربتك، ما مدى احتمال أن تنصح شخصًا مناسبًا بالتقديم إلى الشركة؟
questions.en: Based on your experience, how likely are you to encourage a suitable person to apply to the company?
questions.condition: All outcomes; optional answer / Cannot judge
questions.action: Optional candidate advocacy score: %9–10 minus %0–6. Not eNPS and no external benchmark claimed.

questions.ar: إذا توفرت فرصة مناسبة مستقبلًا، ما مدى استعدادك للنظر في التقديم إلينا؟
questions.en: If a suitable opportunity became available later, how willing would you be to consider applying to us?
questions.condition: Withdrawn / rejection only; exclude signed hires
questions.action: Understand future consideration without conflating it with current offer acceptance.

questions.ar: ما التغيير الواحد الذي كان سيحسّن تجربتك معنا أكثر من غيره؟
questions.en: What one change would have made the biggest improvement to your experience with us?
questions.condition: All outcomes; optional response
questions.action: Prioritize recurring process issues; HR reviews comments in context.

QUALITY.ar: 1 سيئ جدًا | 2 سيئ | 3 مقبول | 4 جيد | 5 ممتاز
QUALITY.en: 1 Very poor | 2 Poor | 3 Acceptable | 4 Good | 5 Excellent
QUALITY.notes: N/A / Cannot recall where appropriate. C01 additionally has No updates received; do not treat that as N/A.

CLARITY.ar: 1 غير واضح إطلاقًا | 2 غير واضح إلى حد كبير | 3 واضح جزئيًا | 4 واضح | 5 واضح تمامًا
CLARITY.en: 1 Not at all clear | 2 Mostly unclear | 3 Partly clear | 4 Clear | 5 Completely clear

EASE.ar: 1 صعب جدًا | 2 صعب | 3 لا سهل ولا صعب | 4 سهل | 5 سهل جدًا
EASE.en: 1 Very difficult | 2 Difficult | 3 Neither easy nor difficult | 4 Easy | 5 Very easy
EASE.notes: Not applicable if no application form was completed.

IMPRESSION.ar: 1 سلبي جدًا | 2 سلبي | 3 محايد | 4 إيجابي | 5 إيجابي جدًا
IMPRESSION.en: 1 Very negative | 2 Negative | 3 Neutral | 4 Positive | 5 Very positive
IMPRESSION.notes: Separate: No clear impression / Cannot recall (before); Not enough information (after). Never code as neutral.

OPPORTUNITY.ar: 1 لا فرصة إطلاقًا | 2 فرصة قليلة | 3 فرصة متوسطة | 4 فرصة كبيرة | 5 فرصة كبيرة جدًا
OPPORTUNITY.en: 1 None | 2 A little | 3 A moderate amount | 4 A lot | 5 A great deal

RELEVANCE.ar: 1 غير مرتبط إطلاقًا | 2 ارتباط ضعيف | 3 ارتباط متوسط | 4 مرتبط بدرجة كبيرة | 5 مرتبط تمامًا
RELEVANCE.en: 1 Not at all related | 2 Slightly related | 3 Moderately related | 4 Very related | 5 Completely related

REASONABLENESS.ar: 1 غير مناسب إطلاقًا | 2 غير مناسب غالبًا | 3 مناسب جزئيًا | 4 مناسب | 5 مناسب جدًا
REASONABLENESS.en: 1 Very unreasonable | 2 Unreasonable | 3 Partly reasonable | 4 Reasonable | 5 Very reasonable

SUFFICIENCY.ar: 1 غير كافٍ إطلاقًا | 2 غير كافٍ غالبًا | 3 كافٍ جزئيًا | 4 كافٍ | 5 كافٍ تمامًا
SUFFICIENCY.en: 1 Not at all sufficient | 2 Mostly insufficient | 3 Partly sufficient | 4 Sufficient | 5 Fully sufficient

SATISFACTION.ar: 1 غير راضٍ جدًا | 2 غير راضٍ | 3 لا راضٍ ولا غير راضٍ | 4 راضٍ | 5 راضٍ جدًا
SATISFACTION.en: 1 Very dissatisfied | 2 Dissatisfied | 3 Neither satisfied nor dissatisfied | 4 Satisfied | 5 Very satisfied

LIKELIHOOD_0_10.ar: 0 غير محتمل إطلاقًا إلى 10 محتمل للغاية
LIKELIHOOD_0_10.en: 0 Not at all likely to 10 Extremely likely
LIKELIHOOD_0_10.notes: Cannot judge / Prefer not to answer; exclude these from calculation.

WILLINGNESS.ar: 1 غير مستعد إطلاقًا | 2 غير مستعد | 3 غير متأكد | 4 مستعد | 5 مستعد جدًا
WILLINGNESS.en: 1 Very unwilling | 2 Unwilling | 3 Unsure | 4 Willing | 5 Very willing

YES_NO_UNSURE.notes: If not Yes, skip prior reputation detail.

YES_NO_PREFER_NOT.en: Yes | No | Prefer not to answer
YES_NO_PREFER_NOT.notes: If Yes, allow an optional comment without identifying details.

JOB_SOURCE.ar: LinkedIn | موقع الشركة | منصة وظائف | ترشيح موظف | معرفة شخصية | وكالة توظيف | تواصل مباشر من الشركة | نقابة/جامعة/فعالية | مصدر آخر | لا أتذكر
JOB_SOURCE.en: LinkedIn | Company careers site | Job board | Employee referral | Personal contact | Recruitment agency | Direct outreach from the company | Association/university/event | Other | Cannot recall
JOB_SOURCE.notes: Single choice; if Job board, optionally choose Bayt / Akhtaboot / other. No referrer names.

REPUTATION_SOURCES.ar: موظفون حاليون | موظفون سابقون | معارف | LinkedIn | موقع الشركة | مواقع تقييم أصحاب العمل | أخبار/فعاليات مهنية | مصدر آخر | لا أتذكر
REPUTATION_SOURCES.en: Current employees | Former employees | Personal contacts | LinkedIn | Company website | Employer review sites | News/professional events | Other | Cannot recall
REPUTATION_SOURCES.notes: Multiple choice. Do not ask who said what by name.

ASSESSMENT_BARRIER.ar: لا عوائق | مشكلة تقنية | تعليمات غير واضحة | صعوبة في ترتيب الوقت | حاجة لدعم في الوصول | عائق آخر | أفضل عدم الإجابة
ASSESSMENT_BARRIER.en: No barriers | Technical issue | Unclear instructions | Scheduling difficulty | Accessibility support needed | Other | Prefer not to answer
ASSESSMENT_BARRIER.notes: Multiple choice; No barriers and Prefer not to answer are exclusive. Do not request medical details.

STAGE_GAP.ar: التقديم–المكالمة | المكالمة–HR | HR–التقنية | التقنية–الاختبار | الاختبار–النهائية | النهائية–التحقق | التحقق–القرار | أخرى | لا أتذكر
STAGE_GAP.en: Application–screening | Screening–HR | HR–technical | Technical–assessment | Assessment–final | Final–checks | Checks–decision | Other | Cannot recall
STAGE_GAP.notes: Only show transitions actually experienced; allow gaps caused by skipped stages.

OFFER_DIFFERENCE.ar: نعم | لا | غير متأكد | أفضل عدم الإجابة
OFFER_DIFFERENCE.en: Yes | No | Unsure | Prefer not to answer
OFFER_DIFFERENCE.notes: If Yes: optional comment. No salary amounts required.

WITHDRAWAL_REASON.ar: قبول فرصة أخرى | الراتب/المزايا المتوقعة | عدم ملاءمة الدور | الموقع/نمط العمل | مدة الإجراءات | التواصل | تجربة مقابلة | متطلبات الاختبار | انطباعي عن الشركة | ظروف شخصية | سبب آخر | أفضل عدم الإجابة
WITHDRAWAL_REASON.en: Accepted another opportunity | Expected pay/benefits | Role fit | Location/work arrangement | Process duration | Communication | Interview experience | Assessment requirements | Impression of the company | Personal circumstances | Other | Prefer not to answer
WITHDRAWAL_REASON.notes: Single primary reason; optional secondary reasons should be analysed separately.

ACCEPTANCE_REASON.ar: طبيعة الدور | التعويضات | فرص التطور | الانطباع عن المدير/الفريق | سمعة الشركة | الموقع/نمط العمل | تجربة التوظيف | عامل آخر | أفضل عدم الإجابة
ACCEPTANCE_REASON.en: Role itself | Compensation | Development prospects | Impression of manager/team | Company reputation | Location/work arrangement | Recruitment experience | Other | Prefer not to answer

TEXT.ar: إجابة اختيارية؛ لا تذكر أسماء أو تفاصيل تكشف هويتك في مسار الرفض
TEXT.en: Optional free text; do not include names or identifying details in the rejection pathway
TEXT.notes: Do not require comments or automatically infer truth, motive or misconduct from them.
